definitions.explanation: To accept or pick up electronic communications or signals that have been sent. The counterpart of {送信|そうしん}する.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受信|じゅしん}した。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受信|じゅしん}しにくい。
examples.english: It's hard to receive a signal in this room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦{地震|じしん}{速報|そくほう}→地震速報：20820_jishinsokuhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受信|じゅしん}する⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{警告音|けいこくおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: When an emergency earthquake alert is received, a warning sound goes off on the smartphone.

notes:
The counterpart of ⟦{送信|そうしん}する→送信する：26780_soushinsuru⟧ (to send/transmit). Used for receiving electronic communications, broadcast signals, or data. The noun form ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧ is also common in compound words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受信|じゅしん}する: to receive an email
- ⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受信|じゅしん}する: to receive a radio signal
- ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧トレイ: inbox
- ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧: blocking reception (of calls/messages)
- ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: reception fee (e.g., NHK)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive — general-purpose; includes physical items
- ⟦{着信|ちゃくしん}→着信：07685_chakushin⟧: incoming call/message — specifically for phone calls and notifications
- {傍受|ぼうじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to intercept — receiving communications not intended for you
